age.raw: Must be 18 years of age for Camp Counselor and Camp Director positions

other: Criminal background check; no felony or misdemeanor convictions related to abuse or neglect
Be able to obtain first aid and CPR certifications
issues: The carried-forward record treated these as high school opportunities. The Park Authority's own page sets an age floor of 18 for both roles, so they are reclassified out of scope. The separate Counselor-in-Training route is the in-scope path and is tracked under its own record.
All camp positions have been filled for Summer 2026
